office_does: The East District Court judge in Goldendale hears infractions, misdemeanors, civil and small claims cases and protection orders; only East District voters elect the judge.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Rick L Hansen, on the East District Court bench since 2010, is the only candidate. Only voters in the East District Court district vote on this seat.

candidates.summary: East District Court judge since 2010 and a Goldendale lawyer since 1984; the only candidate.
